# Goblin Ringleader (M20)
# Haste (compiled keyword)
# When this creature enters, reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all Goblin cards
# revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
# "All Goblin cards" = a mandatory ONE_OF partition of the revealed window with count 4 (the
# window's size): QConst picks carry no stop token and clamp at the Goblins present, so every
# Goblin among the four goes to hand; REST sends the others to the bottom.
_top = (Zone(kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY, controller=ControllerRef.YOU, position=ZonePosition.TOP),)
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.REVEAL, {'controller': ControllerRef.YOU, 'count': QConst(value=4)}),
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=4),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ONE_OF,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Goblin'),
                    zones=_top,
                ),
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            }),
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'cards': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.REST,
                    filter=FAnd(children=()),
                    zones=_top,
                ),
                'destination': Zone(
                    kind=ZoneKind.LIBRARY,
                    controller=ControllerRef.YOU,
                    position=ZonePosition.BOTTOM,
                ),
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]
